consumer: an agent-platform operator deciding whether to fund context reduction, retrieval, or turn-elimination work before building an intervention
gate: Do not price or build a context intervention until a run produces a receipted retransmission share, candidate-turn denominator, and deterministic what-if bound for the same session corpus.
observed_defect: The shipped route-backtest priced model substitution while usage-shape found retransmitted context dominating billed tokens; the earlier backtest measured the wrong lever before shape census. Public adjacent prior art reports retrieval reranking moving a target passage from fifth to first seven times instead of once, but that is prior-art context, not this lane's measurement.

demo.name: Context retransmit backtest
arms: known-shape synthetic fixture recovers cacheRead/cacheWrite/input/output exactly
all-zero-cache fixture proves no retransmission is not silently invented
missing-usage assistant turn is counted separately from non-turn records
malformed/truncated JSONL fails with a named receipt failure
output: candidate intervention set: turns above declared cache-read share threshold
deterministic what-if table for 25%, 50%, and 75% retransmission reduction
denominator: sessions, assistant turns, usage-bearing turns, missing-usage turns, skipped/non-turn records
source hashes, model/version fields, date, accounting mode, and explicit UNRECONCILED residual
demo.boundary: A what-if token reduction is an upper-bound scenario, not proof that retrieval, top_k, or turn elimination preserves answer quality.

retirement_condition: Retire or merge this demo when a maintained tool accepts the same session inputs, emits stronger per-turn provenance and accounting, and reproduces the same known-shape/negative controls; do not retire because one real run is green.
no_claim: No implementation, no live model call, no quality-preservation claim, and no external validation of the Isaac Flath prior-art figure.
